metamorphic_relations.name: Object floating or shaking in air
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an object or vehicle hovering above the ground, suspended in mid-air, bouncing in place without ground contact, or shaking and spinning while airborne?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character or animal launched into sky
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character, NPC, or animal (cow, deer) catapulted unnaturally high into the sky or flung sideways into the air from a minor interaction? The launch force is vastly disproportionate to the cause.

metamorphic_relations.name: Corpse or dead body animation anomaly
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a dead body twitching, bouncing up and down on the ground, holding a limb rigidly in the air, or moving in ways a corpse should not? The character is clearly dead but still animating.

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC walks with twisted or distorted legs
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an NPC walking or running with legs bent in the wrong direction, twisted around each other, or clipping through their own body?

metamorphic_relations.name: Body clips through vehicle
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character or corpse pass through a closed vehicle door, slide under a helicopter, or have their body visibly inside a vehicle's solid shell?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle teleports to new position
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a vehicle instantly appear on top of another vehicle, or snap to a completely different position without driving there?

metamorphic_relations.name: Object spinning after crash
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an object like a vehicle or aircraft continuously rotating in place after crashing into an object, spinning like a top instead of coming to rest?

metamorphic_relations.name: Mission softlocks after respawn
metamorphic_relations.check: After the main character dies and respawns during a story mission, does the next cutscene or scripted trigger never start, leaving you stuck with no way to continue?

metamorphic_relations.name: Player trapped inside bunker with unusable doors
metamorphic_relations.check: Does the game spawn an object inside a place and the doors cannot be opened or interacted with, trapping you in the area permanently?

metamorphic_relations.name: Mission completion blocked by NPC dialogue state
metamorphic_relations.check: After completing the main action of a mission, can you no longer finish it because the NPC acts like something is still happening?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC stuck in idle animation loop
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an NPC frozen in place, repeating the same idle animation without responding to player interaction or progressing their behavior?
